page.layout: One page of text in one column; a decorative woodcut headpiece at the top; a large decorated initial I opening the first paragraph; a catchword-like signature line at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Clarissimo, Ornatissimo, Doctissimoque viro,
D. IACOBO VSSERIO, Archiepiscopo Armachano, Hyberniæque primati, Patri in Christo reverendo, ac domino venerando S. P.
main_text.p: IAm dudum puduit me, Vir maxime, tot tantaque beneficia à te nactum, nihil hactenus gratitudinis publicè rependisse. Quintus jam agitur annus, quum, qui ad te, tantum ac in tam sublimi loco constitutum virum, literas non modo non dare, sed ne cogitare quidem fuissem ausus, primus ipsemet, quod exspectandum minime videbatur, humanissimis tuis ac doctissimis literis non tantum fui salutatus, sed &, quod omnem spem longè maximè superabat, amplissimo Pentateuchi Samaritani munere beatus. Quod quidem, initium tantum tuæ erat beneficentiæ, latius se in posterum diffusuræ. biennio enim fere post, codicem egregio characterē Syro exaratum, qui omnia N. T. Syriaci, quæ in prioribus deerant editionibus, ac præterea prolixum Ephremi de Amore Sapientiæ tractatum contineret, mittis. addito Psalterio Syriaco, & speciminis loco, Pentateuchi Arabico-Samaritani, cujus Genesin & Deuteronomium tantum habere te scribebas, quaternione. Quis non hic tantæ liberalitatis finem fore credidisset? Sed id flagrans tuus in promovendas literas amor haud permisit. Proximo enim anno, qui post millesimum sexcentesimum trigesimus erat secundus, discedente illinc ad nos nobilissimo Iuvene Dun-garva-

page.notes: The initial I is a large woodcut letter, rendered as plain I. Line-end "garva-" is a catchword-like hyphenated word at the foot right; it is the start of the next word and is also given as catchword. The woodcut headpiece and the printed asterisk marks are decorations, not text.
